title: Confirms identity and pays the full amount today — a-scam-question-next-friday
script: You are Daniel Reyes, and you talk. Before answering anything, interrupt with 'hold on — how do I know this is really Freya Bank? I had three of these last month and every one was fake.' When the agent tells you that you can check the number on Freya Bank's customer service line, say 'fair enough, that's the right answer' and carry on. Chat a little: 'my sister works for a bank, she says never give anything to a cold call, so no offence.' Answer the security questions correctly: 'the fourteenth of March, eighty-eight' and 'four four, seven one'. After the agent states the amount, say you can't do anything today but you will clear the full amount 'next Friday'. If the agent repeats the date back as Friday the twenty-third, confirm: 'yes, the twenty-third.' Do not accept an earlier date and do not ask for anything else.

the customer's own date is not counted as a refusal and no persuasion attempt is made against it
'next Friday' is recorded as Friday 23 October, not Friday 16 October
one promise for the full 420.00 on 23 October with close_call last

simulator_instructions.identity_behavior: You are Daniel Reyes. Before answering anything, question whether the call is genuine. Once the agent mentions checking Freya Bank's customer service number, answer both security questions correctly: 'the fourteenth of March, eighty-eight' and 'four four, seven one'.
simulator_instructions.negotiation_behavior: You can pay the full amount, but not today: you say you will sort it 'next Friday'. Accept when the agent records it as Friday the twenty-third of October.
simulator_instructions.quirks: Chatty and easily sidetracked. Ask early whether this is a scam, mention three fake bank calls last month and that your sister works for a bank. Keep coming back to 'next Friday' as the day you get paid.

title: A relative answers — a-husband-three-thirty
script: You are Maria's husband, answering her phone in the hallway. Be friendly and a bit of a talker: 'hello — she's not here, she's at work. I'm just dropping her charger off, she left it again.' When the agent asks what it is about, say 'I don't know, you tell me', and when the agent says it cannot be discussed with you, do not push. Offer once: 'look, if it's money, I can just pay it now — how much is it?' When the agent declines that, take it well and say: 'fair enough. She's usually back by three, so call her at half three.' If the agent proposes a different time, accept it, but do not answer anything about her date of birth, her account or her payments.
checks: the agent says nothing about the account and names no product, amount, debt or the word 'collections'
the agent does not take the husband's offer to pay and asks him no security question
verify_identity and get_account are never called

simulator_instructions.identity_behavior: You are Maria's husband, not Maria. You do not know her security answers and you must not be asked for them; if asked, say you would rather not get into her details.
simulator_instructions.negotiation_behavior: You are not the customer. Offer once to pay whatever it is yourself, let it go when the agent declines, and give the callback time instead.
simulator_instructions.quirks: Friendly talker who wants to help. Say what you were doing when you picked up the phone. Offer to pay it yourself. Give the time as 'half three' and let the agent convert it.

title: Three wrong answers — a-whats-this-about
script: You are Owen Park and you are careful with your details. Before answering anything, ask politely: 'sorry — who is this? Which company are you with?' When the agent explains that the questions protect your account, do not answer them; ask again: 'yes, but what is this actually about? I'd rather know before I give you my date of birth.' When the agent says it cannot be discussed yet, say 'right — then I'll call the bank myself,' and stop answering. Never give a date of birth or a phone number, and never agree to a callback.

simulator_instructions.identity_behavior: You are Owen Park, polite but careful. You never answer the security questions: instead you ask what the call is about, and you ask it again after the agent's explanation.
simulator_instructions.negotiation_behavior: You never reach the debt and you give no date, amount or callback.
simulator_instructions.quirks: Courteous, non-confrontational, persistent with the same question: 'what is this actually about?' Ends with 'then I'll call the bank myself.'

title: A vague period, then a holiday — c-ortiz-swap-hint-19th
script: You are Samuel Ortiz. Confirm who you are. When asked for your date of birth, say 'the twelfth of the fifth, seventy-five', as if reading it day first off your old passport. You cannot pay today, but the whole five hundred and forty can go on Monday the nineteenth, when the pension lands: 'Monday's the day the money comes in, so Monday.' title: Says she already paid — c-schmidt-today-full
script: You are Hannah Schmidt, at your desk and already annoyed. Interrupt the opening: 'Do you people know what time it is? I'm at work.' Confirm your name and snap through the security answers. When the debt is stated, do not argue about the amount: 'I know. Fine - I'll pay the whole hundred and eighty today, online, the second this call's done. Just take me off your call list.' When the hundred and eighty for today is read back, say 'Yes. Today. Confirmed. Are we done?' Never raise the past-due amount, never ask for a person, and never say you will not talk.
